name: Hara Aki
source: Married to the Hara house in a political marriage of convenience. She loathes her homely husband, Shouji, and is always making up excuses to not sleep with him. She loves luxury and spending money, and eats up the Hara house's fortune rapidly. She isn't a wicked person by nature, but is simply a selfish princess who is ignorant of the ways of the world.
